title: AC1032 direct-NOD WIPEOUTVARIABLES frame-0 source and bounded output
scope: Admit a same-revision AC1032 DWG WIPEOUTVARIABLES record only for the observed direct named-object dictionary owner/reactor and display-frame 0 profile. Existing AC1024 and AC1027 routes remain; AC1032 nested, other versions, nonzero direct display modes and cross-revision output remain refused.

source.provenance: Locally authored from scratch with ezdxf 1.4.5 using tools/author_wipeout_direct_nod.py, converted to ACAD2018 DWG and back to DXF with ODA File Converter 27.1.0. No DWG or DXF fixture was added. Regenerated drawing hashes can differ.
source.independent: LibreDWG 0.14 identifies NOD 0xA entry ACAD_WIPEOUT_VARS -> object 0x30, AC1032 object with dynamic type 514, display frame 0, parent soft-pointer role 4 -> 0xA, one reactor soft-pointer role 4 -> 0xA, missing XDICTIONARY and data-storage bit 0. The ODA paired DXF contains the corresponding root entry and object.
source.frame: The in-tree source capture, followed by a separate witness-specific bit walk, checks a 10-byte frame 44804c24068821482140 and 37 handle-stream bits. Type [0,10), self [10,26), empty EED [26,28), reactor count [28,38), xdict-missing [38,39), data-storage bit [39,40), frame-0 BS [40,42), absent string marker [42,43), owner role-4 token [43,59), reactor role-4 token [59,75), and five zero pad bits [75,80) are observed. Page decompression and raw frame capture are in-tree; the bit walk is not an independent container decoder.

implementation: The existing graph walker, direct reactor back-edge treatment, named-root selection and source preflight recognize the AC1032 direct profile alongside AC1024/AC1027. The version-specific bit observer checks the R2013+ storage bit and exact two reference roles; raw version must equal document version and raw data-storage metadata must match the typed record. Class/source identity, unique root key/target, staged output and source/frame correlation remain mandatory. AC1032 nested owner records are still refused.

validation.generatedControls: AC1032, AC1024 and AC1027 generated direct-root ASCII/Binary output, mapped root/object/reactor/owner typed readback, sentinel preservation and corrected same-adapter retries. Mutations cover wrong source-frame version, raw data-storage metadata, encoded data-storage bit in AC1027/AC1032, owner and reactor roles, typed reactor/owner/extension flag, root aliases/duplicates/key, wrong target revision and unsupported display values. An AC1032 nested source with valid display 1 is refused atomically; AC1027 nested remains passing.

reproduce: For the exact retained witness only, run tools/audit_wipeout_ac1032_source.py with the compiled source probe; for regenerated bytes, independently bind the new input hash and inspect its fields rather than bypassing the hash check.
remaining: Qualify physical whole-document output, proxy-preview preservation, independent/native rendering and additional producer/version/mode profiles before any support promotion.
